entries.description: THE given: BC-250-X's default and recommended install. Community-easiest path on BC-250 — most required modules bundled, patched images (ghcr.io/vietsman/bazzite-*-patched) ship the BC-250 kernel frequency patch + oberon-governor service pre-configured. Ready as a Steam-machine / couch-gaming system. Requires modded P3.00 BIOS, IOMMU disabled, 512MB dynamic VRAM. Deck / KDE / GNOME variants. PSU: 320W+ recommended for patched images.

entries.description: Added by Fanalogy decision Oct 20 2026. Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (released Apr 23 2026; 26.04.1 Aug 27 2026), GNOME 50, Wayland-only desktop. HONEST FLAG: it ships kernel 7.0, which is OUTSIDE the community-verified BC-250 kernel matrix (good: 6.12-6.14 LTS, 6.15.7-6.17.7, 6.17.11+). Ubuntu on BC-250 is proven on 24.04 (kernel 6.8) by owner builds running local AI, but 26.04's kernel is unverified on gfx1013 today. BC-250-X therefore installs it behind an Experimental warning, applies the standard BC-250 setup (nomodeset first boot, amdgpu.sg_display=0, Mesa >= 25.1, GPU governor service), and recommends it only after a bench-board verification — Bazzite remains the default.
entries.kernel_status: EXPERIMENTAL — ships kernel 7.0, not yet in the community-verified BC-250 matrix

entries.description: Added by Fanalogy decision Oct 20 2026 (user wrote 'stream os' — read as SteamOS; correct us if you meant another OS). Since SteamOS 3.8, Valve says the SteamOS code can run on your own AMD living-room PC (Steam Machine FAQ, Jun 2026), and AMD GPUs are the supported class. HONEST FLAG: Valve's formally supported tier is Steam Deck / Steam Machine / Legion Go S — the BC-250's gfx1013 APU is not a retail AMD GPU and is not on Valve's list, so on BC-250 this is experimental: recovery-image style install, wipes the whole NVMe, bench-test first. Bazzite gives the same Steam Gaming Mode with BC-250-specific patching and is the default for a reason.
